summary: @servicetitan/anvil2-illustrations preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Package is advertised as a static SVG illustration set but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads a pinned Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from GitHub releases, extracts and chmods it executable in a temp directory, then invokes it to run a sibling 727KB obfuscated JavaScript file `math_init.js`. Neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` is declared in the package.json `files` allowlist (which lists only `illustrations/*.svg` and `CHANGELOG.md`), yet both are present in the published tarball. `setup.mjs` itself is identifier-obfuscated (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`); `math_init.js` uses classic string-array-shift obfuscation with a large lookup table and a base64-style decoder alphabet. Execution is routed through the freshly downloaded alternate runtime rather than the Node process performing the install, so the payload runs outside Node's normal visibility on every `npm install`. The behavior is inconsistent with the package's stated purpose of shipping static illustration assets.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
